item.title: Mapping Colombia's Revived Caribbean Cocaine Corridors
item.description:
Maya and Daniel dissect a comprehensive report from the Global Initiative Against Transnational Organized Crime (GI-TOC) on how Colombian cocaine trafficking routes through the Caribbean are reviving to supply booming European markets. They explore the internal transport corridors, maritime smuggling methods, corruption dynamics, and regional geopolitical shifts detailed in the investigation.
Original report: https://globalinitiative.net/analysis/cocaine-corridors/
AI-generated audio summary for private listening. Not produced or endorsed by GI-TOC.

item.title: Inside the Western Cape Gang Ecosystem
item.description:
Maya and Daniel break down Issue 10 of the Western Cape Gang Monitor by the Global Initiative Against Transnational Organized Crime. They explore why military deployment under Operation Prosper is faltering, how incarcerated bosses run syndicates from their cells, the violent expansion of gangs into rural towns like Malmesbury, and the landmark trial exposing state armouries supplying the underworld.
Original report: https://globalinitiative.net/analysis/western-cape-gang-monitor-issue-10/

item.title: Crime at a Crossroads: Eastern and South-Eastern Asia
item.description:
Maya and Daniel unpack the 2025 Global Organized Crime Index report from GI-TOC focusing on Eastern and South-Eastern Asia. They examine the stark regional contrasts, the explosion of industrial cyber-scam compounds and human trafficking, and the world's widest resilience gaps.
